versat: versō, -āre — to turn over, ponder (3rd sg. pres.)
vertice: vertex, verticis (m.) — peak, summit; whirl (abl. sg.)
vim: vīs (f.; acc. vim, abl. vī) — force, power, violence (acc. sg.)
vires: vīs (f.) — force; pl. vīrēs, strength (acc. pl.) · also nom. pl. (fractae vīrēs)
viri: vir, virī (m.) — man, hero, husband (nom. pl.; gen. sg.) · also voc. pl. (festīnāte, virī)
vocati: vocō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to call, summon (perf. pass. part., m. nom. pl.)
voces: vōx, vōcis (f.) — voice, word, utterance (acc. pl.; also nom. pl.)
volumina: volūmen, -inis (n.) — coil, fold, roll, wreath (acc. pl.)
